context_requirements: Functional androgen receptor signaling is required for transcriptional consequences of androgen deprivation
Expression of CYP17A1 and/or CYP11B1 in the cell line
Dependence on autocrine or paracrine androgen biosynthesis for growth/survival
Steroidogenic enzyme activity sufficient to produce measurable androgen levels
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional response at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Changes in canonical androgen receptor target genes (e.g., KLK3, TMPRSS2, FKBP5) in any line
Evidence of CYP17A1 or CYP11B1 expression and activity in these lines
Growth inhibition or apoptosis at 10 micromolar in AR-positive lines such as LNCaP or VCaP
